messages.subject: Senior Executive Candidate | External Affairs, ESG, Sustainability & Country Leadership | GCC
messages.body:
Dear Nikki,

I am reaching out for confidential consideration for senior opportunities across the GCC and wider international market. I currently serve as Liaison Director at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with leadership responsibilities across government and regulatory relations, ESG, social responsibility, corporate affairs, stakeholder strategy, compliance coordination and cross-functional execution in a major multinational mining environment.

My career spans more than 12 years across multinational mining, regulated financial services and commercial operations. I am internationally mobile and interested in Director, Head, Country, External Affairs, Government Relations, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships, Business Development and related leadership mandates.

My executive CV is attached. I would welcome a confidential discussion regarding suitable mandates.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
